page.layout: One printed page, main text in one column with a woodcut headpiece above the title; a narrow strip of marginal text (fragments of a neighbouring page's edge) at the right edge, not transcribed as notes.

main_text.head: EPISTOLA CLARISSIMI & Excellentissimi JCti, DN. GEORGII REMI, Consiliarii Norici.
main_text.p: Sin Christo, τῷ Ἰωανθρώπῳ, μεσίτῃ καὶ ἱκέτῃ: quem, Vir reverende & praestantissime, Domine Luci, contra impurum Socinianum, os βλάσφημον, REDEMPTOREM defendis acerrimè, accuratissimeque. Ajo Tibi, me non solùm magnâ cum voluptate, sed etiam utilitate, disputationem tuam legisse. Agonem ajo te agonisâsse bonum Ecclesiæ CHRISTI praclaram impendisse operam: dum Gittichii hujus φλυαρίας, ἀμφιβολογίας, ἀπατήματα, ψευδολογαφήματα, καὶ στρογγυλισμένες λόγες, tam dilucidè, tam solidè refutasti. Diu est, cùm tantam tuam eruditionem in Te meritò admiror, gratiasque ago Tibi nostrorum nomine; qui tam aperto Marte, tam exprompte, occurris Nebuloni; quidquid se viri boni lar vâ obvelet. Redit ergo ad te OPUS hoc tuum, mole parvum; reapse maximum Tibi

page.notes: Woodcut initial "S" and printed Greek transcribed as far as legible; a few Greek words are uncertain and may contain errors. The last line of the page is partly cut by the binding edge ("Tibi" is the catchword-like fragment at the foot, kept in the text). Neighbouring page edge at the right is not transcribed.
